messages:
maya: Created RC build and pinned artifacts: rc-2026-03-18-3 (sha: 6f3a2c). Pinning image to Dedicated pools. @release-bot can you post artifact details and schedule? :rocket:
release-bot: Artifact recorded:
```
image: redwood/inference:rc-2026-03-18-3-6f3a2c
sha256: 3a7b9f2c... (truncated)
size: 1.8GB
pinned_pools: dp-prod-gpu-1, dp-prod-gpu-2
```
release-bot: Suggested rollout plan: canary 10% for 30m -> 50% for 30m -> 100%. Change window proposed: 2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Schedule?
maya: Yes please schedule for that window. Canary health checks -> latency and 5xx thresholds. Pin config: `model=redwood-7b-q4` and no DB migrations.
liam: ack. I'll attach the smoke test checklist and set alerts.
liam: smoke tests:
- token-generation smoke
- embedding sanity
- kv-cache eviction quick check
(should be automated in the RC pipeline)
olivia: Release notes draft: https://internal.redwood/notes/rc-2026-03-18-3 (draft). I'll publish once we sign off.
sebastian: quick Q: any schema/db changes? need migration flag?
maya: No schema changes. It's config and quantization tweaks only. Marking `migration=false` on the rollout.
sebastian: ok. Confirming rollback target is `redwood/inference:v2.9.1` if we need to revert.
natalie: I'll update the public changelog and add the customer-facing note about latency improvements.
oncall-bot: Oncall rotation check: oncall is @olivia for the window (2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC). Pager escalation on.
liam: Alert rules created:
- error_rate > 1% for 5m -> page
- p95 latency increase > 50ms vs baseline -> page
- model OOMs -> page
maya: Sign-offs needed: eng-safety (liam), infra (sebastian), docs (natalie), oncall (olivia). Please react with :white_check_mark: when ready.
liam: :white_check_mark:
olivia: :white_check_mark:
sebastian: :white_check_mark: (infra pinned pools validated)
natalie: :white_check_mark: (docs ready)
release-bot: Promotion scheduled: 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z. Canary controller will enforce percentages and rollback on failed health checks.
release-bot: Starting canary at 2026-03-19T02:00:30Z -> 10% traffic.
release-bot: Canary metrics (30m): error_rate 0.32% (baseline 0.28%), p95 latency +8ms. No OOMs.
olivia: metrics look good to me. Moving to 50% now.
release-bot: Scaling canary to 50% at 2026-03-19T02:35:12Z. Monitoring closely.
liam: running smoke tests again post-50% -> all green (0 failures).
release-bot: Promotion to 100% complete at 2026-03-19T02:45:01Z. New prod tag: redwood/inference:rc-2026-03-18-3-6f3a2c.
sebastian: Confirmed rollout. Creating rollback playbook snippet in runbook: rollback if any of:
- sustained error_rate > 1% for 10m
- p95 increase > 50ms for 10m
- client-side 5xx spike > 2%
Rollback command (k8s):
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:v2.9.1 --namespace prod
```
maya: If we trigger rollback, also set a temporary traffic-split to route 100% to v2.9.1 and open incident channel. Keep the RC image immutable for investigation.
natalie: Published final release notes and customer email queued.
liam: Closing checklist: postmortem threshold set to 1% errors. Logging retention for the window increased to 14 days.
olivia: :tada: all good from oncall.
release-bot: Promotion event recorded in audit logs. Tags: [rc, pinned, rollout-2026-03-19].
maya: Thanks everyone — RC promoted to prod and pinned. I'll follow up tomorrow with perf numbers and cost delta.
